## Summary

- 3.5+ years across enterprise web apps, internal portals, IoT access control, eCommerce, analytics dashboards and AI tooling.
- Core stack: .NET Core (C#), ASP.NET MVC, REST APIs, React, Angular, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux.
- AI work: MCP servers with 100+ tools exposed to agents, RAG pipelines over ERP and payroll data, containerised agents on Azure AI Foundry, prompt-injection checks, per-tenant rate limits, caching and context budgeting for cost control.
- Security: OWASP Top 10, secure authentication and authorization, input validation, API hardening.
